content.short: UR combines a Swiss IBAN, seven fiat currencies and stablecoins in a single account.
content.description: UR provides a single account holding both stablecoins and fiat, with a Swiss IBAN, seven fiat currencies and more than twenty digital assets behind one API. Payments reach SEPA, SWIFT and Mastercard rails, with deposits backed one-to-one and anchored on an auditable ledger. KYC and AML controls are built in and independently audited to global regulatory standards. Wallets, developers and financial platforms integrate it to keep users from leaving for an external off-ramp, with go-live measured in weeks.
